PullRequests.title: fix(web): prevent flash of incorrect workspace tasks on load
PullRequests.body:
# Pull Request

## Description

_Summary_

This PR fixes a bug where tasks from a previously viewed workspace briefly appeared before the correct tasks loaded.

_What was the issue_

When switching between workspaces (teams), React Query served cached task data from the previously viewed team, resulting in a temporary flash of incorrect tasks until the new data was fetched and rendered.

_What was the fix_

To prevent this, now:
	Immediately clear tasks when a team change is detected.
	Invalidate and remove queries for the previously selected team to ensure stale task data is cleared before new data is loaded.
This change ensures users only see tasks relevant to their current workspace, improving data accuracy and preventing confusion caused by flashing outdated task data.

Ticket (ticket)

SQU-610

## Type of change

- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [x] Refactoring (non-breaking change which refactors old code)
- [ ] Design (Affects styling or design components)
- [ ] Documentation (Improvements or additions to documentation)

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Provide instructions so we can reproduce.

- [x] Manually tested switching between different workspaces/teams.
- [x] Verified that no incorrect tasks briefly appear during transition.
- [x] Confirmed only the current team’s tasks are shown after switching.



<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Improved data freshness and cache invalidation when switching teams on the task dashboard.
  - Prevented display of outdated or stale task data after changing teams.
  - Enhanced loading state handling to avoid premature rendering when team information is not fully loaded.

PullRequests.title: Feat restricted controls
PullRequests.body:
# Pull Request

## Description

The goal of this PR was to implement some restricted access to certain controls for users who dont have the required role e.g. workspace settings. I used clerks built in protect component for the settings side bar so users can't view certain navigation links to workspace settings routes e.g. workspace members. Also if non admin users try to navigate to workspace settings routes via the URL the user is then redirected to the settings profile page so they can't view the route. Also this PR fixes a small issue with the getWorkspaceLabals api endpoint in which the wrong id is used. It has now been changed to check externalId.

Ticket [SQU-83](https://app-develop.squaredmade.com/squared/task/SQU-83/restricted-access-controls)

## Type of change

- [X] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [X] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring (non-breaking change which refactors old code)
- [ ] Design (Affects styling or design components)
- [ ] Documentation (Improvements or additions to documentation)

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Provide instructions so we can reproduce.

If you have a member role in Squared check the settings nav bar component and check if you can view the workspace settings navigation links e.g. workspace labels and try to navigate to the route directly in the URL e.g. app/squared/settings/labels . Although if you are an admin you should be able to see the links and be able to navigate to the workspace settings routes.




<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **New Features**
  - Introduced permission-based access control for workspace settings, labels, members, and GitHub integration management. UI elements and actions are now conditionally rendered or protected based on user permissions.
  - Table columns and action buttons in settings pages dynamically adjust visibility and interactivity according to user permissions.

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Updated internal workspace label queries to align with permission and identification standards.

- **Refactor**
  - Replaced role-based UI restrictions with permission-based controls for more granular access management.
  - Removed references to the deprecated "org:owner" role across components and types.

- **Style**
  - Minor formatting improvements for consistency.

- **Chores**
  - Updated global types to reflect current permission and role structures.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
